content.short: Meso Finance is a capital-efficient money market on Aptos designed for low-latency borrowing and lending for users.
content.description: Meso Finance is a high-performance, non-custodial decentralized lending protocol built natively on the Aptos blockchain. Designed for maximum capital efficiency, the platform provides a professional money market environment where users can supply assets to earn interest and borrow against them with sub-second finality. By leveraging the high throughput and security of the Move programming language, Meso Finance delivers a seamless and highly responsive user experience typically associated with centralized platforms. The protocol utilizes a points-based incentive system to reward users.
content.meta: Meso Finance offers decentralized lending and borrowing on Aptos with low latency and capital efficiency. Find it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
